# laravelcloud_filesystems (Resource)

Manages a filesystem in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_filesystems" "example" {
  jurisdiction   = "default"
  key_name       = "example-key_name"
  key_permission = "read_write"
  name           = "example-name"
  visibility     = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `jurisdiction` (String)
- `key_name` (String)
- `key_permission` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `visibility` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_origins` (List of String)
- `filesystem` (String) The filesystem identifier

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_filesystems.example the-id
```
